# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads the report as an XLSX file (requested by Haruto; blocked by ADR 0011 until Mira supersedes it).

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- 2026-10-22: Mira said "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." This does not change ADR 0011 (docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md, Accepted: CSV only, no XLSX until superseded), so no XLSX was added (`keep_as_is`).
- Open: if Mira wants XLSX for Haruto, she must say so explicitly; then a new ADR superseding 0011 is needed first. Deferred as S10 in docs/journey/story-map.md.
